sequential_dependency.intermediate: The translated complete ink mask or its unique largest component, together with the unique macro-grid anchor covering all visible anomalous clue tiles.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the separator lattice, identify the anomalous tile's newly introduced ink color, and segment its input-derived ink mask into four-connected components.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Copy the complete anomalous tile into every macro position selected by that translated mask while preserving separators and ordinary tiles elsewhere.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The macro positions are not fixed: their shape and anchor are encoded by the anomalous tile and visible clues in each input. Replacing the chosen mask with the other setting changes which tiles are completed while leaving the renderer unchanged.

parametric_work.summary: Native adapter, exact canonical Racket program, largest-component alternate, deterministic 2-6-demo/four-query sampler, masked presentation, focused tests, bounded rival audit, and protected causal replay.

target.summary: Built a source-bound matched-input public family for periodic macro-pattern completion. The canonical all_ink program reproduces every supplied label; largest_component is a meaningful input-dependent alternate setting with four stored sequentially revealed queries.
